name: the-mine-works
description: Nine remote MCP servers from The Mine Works with 80 tools: India jobs, company diligence, recruiting, social listening, e-commerce, US and India real estate, lead generation and academic research. Pay per call on Apify.

settings.name: Apify API token
settings.description: Your Apify API token, from https://console.apify.com/account/integrations. Tool calls are pay per call, billed to your own Apify account.

india-jobs-mcp.description: India Jobs MCP, 14 tools. India job market data: Naukri, Indeed India, Foundit, Shine, Apna, CutShort, Hirist, Instahyre and Internshala, plus LinkedIn candidate sourcing and AmbitionBox employer snapshots.

company-diligence-mcp.description: Company Diligence MCP, 13 tools. Company diligence from official sources: SEC EDGAR, GLEIF LEI, EU VIES VAT, US state registries, UK Companies House, CourtListener, USAspending, SAM.gov and FEC, plus Trustpilot and news.

recruiting-jobs-mcp.description: Recruiting and Jobs MCP, 10 tools. Job and candidate data for recruiting: ATS postings (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby), LinkedIn, Indeed, SimplyHired, Naukri and CutShort, plus candidate sourcing and employer snapshots.

social-research-mcp.description: Social Research MCP, 8 tools. Social listening: Reddit, X, Threads, LinkedIn posts, YouTube transcripts, Google News and Google Trends.

ecommerce-intel-mcp.description: E-commerce Intel MCP, 8 tools. Product research: Amazon products and reviews, AliExpress prices, Shopify catalogs, TikTok Shop, Meta Ad Library and Google Trends.

real-estate-mcp.description: Real Estate MCP, 8 tools. US property data: Zillow listings, sales, rentals and property details, plus Redfin, Realtor.com and Airbnb rental supply.

lead-generation-mcp.description: Lead Generation MCP, 8 tools. B2B and local leads: people with work emails, email verification, website contacts, Google Maps, Yellow Pages and Trustpilot.

academic-research-mcp.description: Academic Research MCP, 6 tools. Scholarly search: OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, OpenCitations and PubMed.

india-real-estate-mcp.description: India Real Estate MCP, 5 tools. India property listings: 99acres, MagicBricks, NoBroker and Housing.com. Rent and sale, residential and commercial.
